Nina Roy (CSM): Flagging a sudden cost jump for Meridian Labs this week, ~2.6x tokens. QBR Friday — need a one-slide cause + 2-3 immediate mitigations we can propose.
Caleb Torres (FinOps): I can run sim scenarios (30/90 day smoothing) and a mitigated estimate if we apply throttles or caching. Need per-route breakdown and prompt/completion split. ETA 1.5h.
Ivy Zhang (Onboarding): They enabled a new analysis pipeline last Tue per the rollout notes. I'll confirm whether it uses full-history embeddings.
Dylan Park (Solutions): Quick ask to eng: export top routes and top 50 prompt samples. Also consider temporary model fallback for very long contexts.
eng-usage-bot: Alert m-cc3: meridian_labs tokens +162% vs 30d baseline starting 2024-04-02T09:14:00Z. Top routes: /v1/embed-bulk (49%), /v1/generate (38%).
Caleb Torres (FinOps): Preliminary numbers: baseline weekly ~$6.2k -> current-runrate ~$16.1k. If we enable prefix KV cache + 50rpm cap on embed-bulk, mitigated ~ $8.7k. I'll formalize.
Nina Roy (CSM): For QBR slide we want: 1) one-line cause, 2) numbers row, 3) immediate asks (enable KV cache, temporary 50rpm cap on embed-bulk, and 20-min prompt tightening workshop). Who owns wording?
Dylan Park (Solutions): I'll draft the mitigation bullets and suggested cap verbiage.
Ivy Zhang (Onboarding): I can run the 20-min session Wed or Thu and produce 3 trimmed prompt examples.
Caleb Torres (FinOps): Posting final numbers in ~1h. I will also include an estimated impact on success rate if throttles are applied.
Nina Roy (CSM): Great. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you pick an action. I'll assemble the slide and circulate a dry-run before the QBR.
Dylan Park (Solutions): :white_check_mark: grabbing prompt samples.
Ivy Zhang (Onboarding): :white_check_mark: scheduling workshop.
